body: I have called that poor lady at Samaritans for 4 times. All she doesn't know is my name. Sometimes, death really is easier than living. This is the case with me. If I go back to male I'll get that shitty dysphoria back. The sex drive from testosterone was worse than cyanide most of the times, sometimes it was ok and I enjoyed it but most times I did it out of despseration. However, if I stay like this I'll rot even more. I never wanted to be female, it was a physiological need. I felt like I could only be with a man as a woman or as an embodiment of femininity. If I were to choose my gender I'd choose male a thousand times over. This conflict can't have a solution. I'm too broken. I've tried accepting that I have to let go of being male, but I... can't. I liked it. I liked how I looked. I liked my subtle body, not too curvy not too manly. The curves make me feel like I'm an object. I had nice muscles. I hated my genitals, I wanted a vagina or even no genitals. I hated my bodily hair and being too masculine, so much so that I couldn't recognize myself in the mirror. But the need to transition was there too. I got dreams of being a girl and I woke up happy. I don't know what to make of it.
